observations: BTB-001 now starts in the upper-middle region and separates its two source sentences. Your responsibilities stays together; ended. and didn't. are intentional source-clause lines, not accidental widows.
Ivory practical slides and accessible bronze emphasis add warmth while retaining the charcoal identity. The six-slide rhythm follows the supplied art direction.
The exact responsibilities, distinctions and action sentences are separated into meaningful blocks; negation and safety context remain readable.
The footer is one quiet brand line plus folio, without the former full-width rule and repeated handle line.

Both phone composites are readable at 360px and390px inspection sizes. The square crop keeps the hook; header/footer omission in this stress crop is expected and does not change primary exports. The3:4 crop keeps the full hook.
Longest-hook175/1 and longest-body142/4 are readable and clear of footer. Script examples preserve Try framing and use typography rather than private-message chrome.
No clipping, overlap, missing glyphs or broken visible copy was observed in the inspected proofs.

observations: The index shows real count, treatment/approval filters and clear unpublished/provisional branding status.
The actual BTB-001 page displays all six output PNGs in order with exact-text/accessibility disclosures and editable-source links.
Every other carousel sequence was visually inspected through the final image contact sheets; this does not claim manually opening all 180 gallery HTML pages.
The revised presentation is consistent across the complete library: earlier messages, warm-paper practical material, charcoal openings/distinctions, source-sentence grouping and quiet footer.
Every carousel contains six complete ordered slides. No blank or missing primary asset was observed on the 42 final contact sheets.

The five semantic families retain clear organisation: contrast uses vertical reading order, scripts retain their introduction and example distinction, practical actions use source boundaries, and founder notes stay restrained.

Safety caveats remain full-size body content, rather than miniature disclaimers. No private-chat chrome, portraits, invented emblem, synthetic signature, intrusive review label or visible planning date was observed in artwork.
No apparent clipped text, overlap, missing glyph boxes or accidental isolated final-word line was observed. The specified ended./didn't. reference lines are deliberate source-thought grouping.
The permitted 52px first block in BTB-055/3 was explicitly inspected at full size and 360px and is readable.

independent_contrast_proofs.method: WCAG sRGB relative-luminance formula applied independently to actual text+metadata RGB pairs in48 proof PNG QA records

scope_limits: Actually inspected every final carousel as a six-slide contact-sheet sequence and every cover again on six cover sheets. Contact sheets were resized by the viewing surface; they establish preview-scale visual coverage, not full-size proof-reading of 1080 individual PNGs.

Actually viewed 19 full-size proof PNGs, two phone composites, two crop stress tests, v1/A/B comparison and representative sequences; 13 primary PNGs are byte-identical to those viewed proof images. Additionally viewed final BTB-055/3 full-size and at 360px.

Actually inspected the real gallery index and BTB-001 gallery in Chromium. All other carousel sequences were visually reviewed in final image contact sheets; separate gallery automation covers page/link/control checks.
Exact-copy, font-use, clipping and dimension conclusions across all 1080 rely on the separately identified deterministic machine evidence, in addition to visual observations.
This is agent visual/design QA, not owner editorial approval, founder attestation, clinical/legal clearance, scene capability entitlement or audience-performance validation.
